transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I just can’t make myself do much anymore. I mostly stay in my room, wearing the same clothes, and I don’t do things I used to like, like knitting or journaling or going for walks. When my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely even have the energy to answer her.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. I just feel kind of empty and tired most of the time. I’m not really crying or anything… I just don’t feel much.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like knitting or journaling?
Yeah… I have. I don’t knit or journal anymore, and I don’t really go on walks like I used to. Mostly I just sit in my room in the same clothes and can’t make myself do anything.
Do you feel down or sad most of the time, even when you're not doing anything?
Not really sad, I don’t think. It’s more like… empty. I just sit there and I don’t feel much either way.
Do you feel fatigued or like you have no energy most days, even when you haven't been doing much?

Yeah. Most days I feel like I have no energy at all, even if I’ve just been sitting in my room. I can’t really make myself do things anymore, and sometimes when my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely even feel like answering.
Do you feel down or experience a depressed mood most days, even when nothing specific has happened to make you feel that way?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed. I don’t really feel sad most days… it’s more like I don’t feel much at all.
Have you noticed any trouble thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?
I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t really notice it as a separate thing. Sometimes I just sit there and don’t do much, but I don’t know if that’s trouble thinking or something else.
Have you found it hard to focus on things, like reading or watching TV, or do you feel like your thinking has slowed down lately?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been reading much, and if the TV is on I’m not always paying attention, but I can’t tell if my thinking is slowed down or if I’m just… not that interested.
Have you noticed that you have a hard time thinking clearly, focusing on tasks, or making even small decisions lately?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed it in a clear way. Sometimes I just don’t get things done, but I can’t tell if that’s because I can’t focus or because I just don’t feel like doing them.
Have you had trouble thinking clearly or focusing on things, even simple tasks, lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it like that exactly. I guess sometimes simple stuff doesn’t get done, but I don’t know if that’s because I can’t focus or if I’m just not doing it.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like knitting or journaling, don’t bring you any pleasure anymore?

Yeah… I don’t really enjoy those things anymore. I used to knit and journal and go for walks, but now I mostly just sit in my room. I’ll stay in the same clothes and I can’t really make myself start anything. Even when my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer her.
Have you felt down or experienced a depressed mood most days, nearly all day, even when nothing specific has happened to make you feel that way?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think of it as feeling sad all day. It’s more like… I just feel kind of empty or blank a lot, but I don’t know if I’d call it depressed.
Have you felt down or experienced a depressed mood most days, nearly all day, even when nothing specific has happened to make you feel that way?
I guess I can’t really say for sure. It’s not like I wake up thinking “I’m depressed” every day. I mostly just feel kind of flat or not much of anything, so I don’t know if that counts.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed most of the day, even when nothing in particular has happened to make you feel that way?
I don’t really know. I don’t think of it as being depressed most of the day. It’s more like I feel blank or kind of numb, so I’m not sure how to answer that.
Has doing things you used to enjoy, like knitting or journaling, felt completely unrewarding or without any pleasure lately?

Yeah. I used to knit and write in my journal, or go for walks, but lately I just don’t do any of it. It’s not even that I hate it… I just can’t make myself start, and it doesn’t feel like it would be worth anything. I mostly just sit in my room, sometimes in the same clothes, and when my mom asks what’s wrong I barely have the energy to answer.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed most of the day, even when nothing in particular has happened to make you feel that way?
I still don’t really know how to call it. I wouldn’t say I feel “depressed” most of the day exactly… it’s more like everything feels empty or dull, and I just don’t feel much.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed most of the day, even when nothing in particular has happened to make you feel that way?
I’m not sure. I know I don’t feel good most days, but I don’t always think of it as “down” or “depressed.” It’s more just… flat, I guess. Like I’m here but I don’t feel much.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed most of the day, even when nothing in particular has happened to make you feel that way?
I don’t know… I don’t think I can say it’s like feeling sad all day. It’s more that I feel kind of blank most of the time. Like nothing really gets through.
Would you say that most days, you feel emotionally down or low most of the day, even if it doesn’t feel like sadness or crying?

Yeah… I guess it’s low, but mostly it feels like I just can’t make myself do anything anymore. I sit in my room in the same clothes, and I don’t knit or journal or go on walks like I used to. When my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer her.
Would you say that activities you used to enjoy, like knitting or journaling, feel completely unrewarding or like they don’t bring you any pleasure anymore?

Yeah. I mean, I don’t really get anything out of them anymore. I used to knit or write in my journal, or go for walks, but now I mostly just sit in my room in the same clothes. I can’t make myself start anything, and even when my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer.
